title: Daily Service Desk Support & User Tickets: Present Simple
workplace_track: ITIL Global Service Desk & Incident Escalation
description: Handle IT helpdesk tickets, user account unlocks, and password resets using Present Simple.
learning_objectives: Use Present Simple 3rd person singular for user ticket handling
Formulate standard troubleshooting questions with 'do / does'
Communicate ticket priorities (P1, P2, P3) accurately

questions.prompt: The IT service desk technician _____ password reset requests in ServiceNow.
We usually _____ high-priority P1 tickets within 15 minutes of escalation.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Běžně řešíme P1 tikety...'. Plural subject takes base verb: 'resolve'.

questions.prompt: The enterprise VPN client _____ automatically when the laptop connects to home Wi-Fi.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'VPN klient se spouští'. Singular subject takes '-es': 'launches'.

questions.prompt: _____ the user have administrative rights on the corporate workstation?

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'the user' takes auxiliary 'Does' in Present Simple questions.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Má uživatel administrátorská práva?'. Singular question takes 'Does the user have...?'.

questions.prompt: System administrators _____ new employee accounts in Active Directory.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Správci vytvářejí...'. Plural subject takes base verb: 'create'.

questions.prompt: The user account _____ not unlock automatically after three consecutive failed attempts.

explanations.correct: Singular negative Present Simple takes 'does not unlock'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'has' cannot negate action verbs like this.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Účet se neodemkne automaticky'. Use 'does not unlock'.

questions.prompt: How often _____ the backup system duplicate the database to the cloud?

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'backup system' takes auxiliary 'does': 'How often does the system duplicate...?'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'is' cannot pair with bare base verb 'duplicate'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Jak často zálohovací systém duplikuje...?'. Question requires auxiliary 'does'.

questions.prompt: The security scanner _____ all inbound email attachments for malicious macros.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Bezpečnostní skener kontroluje...'. Singular subject takes '-s': 'inspects'.
questions.workplace_track: Enterprise Cybersecurity, Threat Hunting & Zero Trust

questions.prompt: Our service desk technicians _____ support in both Czech and English.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Technici poskytují...'. Plural subject takes base verb: 'provide'.

questions.prompt: The multi-factor authentication (MFA) prompt _____ after 30 days of inactivity.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Platnost vyprší po 30 dnech'. Singular subject takes '-s': 'expires'.
questions.workplace_track: Enterprise Cybersecurity, Threat Hunting & Zero Trust
